  - main:
    - text: CLASS 12 · FORMAL CALCULUS
    - heading "Rate of Change" [level=1]
    - paragraph: "Position function: s(t)=t²+2t"
    - paragraph: Explore average rate of change between two times and instantaneous rate of change at a given time.
    - text: 18 min ADVANCED CONCEPT graph applications
    - article:
      - heading "POSITION GRAPH" [level=3]
      - button "Zoom in graph":
        - img
      - button "Zoom out graph":
        - img
      - button "Fit graph":
        - img
      - img "Position graph":
        - slider "Graph a point"
        - slider "Graph b point"
        - slider "Graph time point"
        - text: (1, 3) (2, 8) (3, 15) s(t)=t²+2t
      - text: Drag the blue time points or the green point to explore.
    - complementary:
      - heading "RATES AND CALCULATIONS" [level=3]
      - combobox "Distance units":
        - option "meters (m)" [selected]
        - option "feet (ft)"
      - heading "Average rate of change from t=1 to t=3" [level=4]
      - strong: (s(3)−s(1))/(3−1) = 6 m/s
      - paragraph: Where s(1)=3 and s(3)=15
      - heading "Instantaneous rate at t=2" [level=4]
      - strong: v(t)=s'(t)=2t+2
      - text: v(2)=6 m/s
      - heading "Graph Overlays" [level=4]
      - checkbox "Show secant" [checked]
      - text: Show secant
      - checkbox "Show tangent" [checked]
      - text: Show tangent
      - checkbox "Show grid" [checked]
      - text: Show grid
    - heading "SYNCHRONIZED MOTION STRIP (POSITION ON A LINE)" [level=3]
    - text: t=1 s=3 m t=2 s=8 m t=3 s=15 m
    - complementary:
      - text: Playback
      - button "Play motion":
        - img
      - button "Pause motion":
        - img
      - button "Step motion":
        - img
      - combobox "Playback speed":
        - option "1x" [selected]
        - option "2x"
      - checkbox "Loop"
      - text: Loop
    - article:
      - heading "DATA TABLE" [level=3]
      - table:
        - rowgroup:
          - row "t (s) s(t) (m) v(t) (m/s)":
            - columnheader "t (s)"
            - columnheader "s(t) (m)"
            - columnheader "v(t) (m/s)"
        - rowgroup:
          - row "0 0 2":
            - cell "0"
            - cell "0"
            - cell "2"
          - row "1 3 4":
            - cell "1"
            - cell "3"

            - cell "2"

            - cell "8"

            - cell "4"
            - cell "24"
            - cell "10"
    - article:
      - heading "TIME INTERVAL (AVERAGE RATE)" [level=3]
      - text: Start time a
      - slider "Average start time": "1"
      - text: End time b
      - slider "Average end time": "3"
      - status: Average rate = 6 m/s
    - article:
      - heading "INSTANTANEOUS TIME" [level=3]
      - text: Time t
      - slider "Instantaneous time": "2"
      - status: v(2)=6 m/s
    - heading "INTERPRETATION" [level=3]
    - article:
      - heading "Average rate (1 to 3)" [level=4]
      - paragraph: "The object's average velocity is 6 m/s: the slope of the secant line."
    - article:
      - heading "Instantaneous rate (at 2)" [level=4]
      - paragraph: "The object's velocity is 6 m/s: the slope of the tangent line."
    - article:
      - heading "What does it mean?" [level=4]
      - paragraph: At t=2 s, the object moves forward at 6 m/s and is at s=8 m.
    - article:
      - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=3]
      - paragraph: For t=1 to t=3, average velocity is (15−3)/(3−1)=6 m/s.
      - paragraph: At t=2, v(2)=2(2)+2=6 m/s.
      - text: Both methods give 6 m/s.
    - article:
      - heading "COMMON MISCONCEPTION" [level=3]
      - text: Average rate is not the same as instantaneous rate.
      - paragraph: The average rate over an interval is the slope of a secant. The instantaneous rate at a point is the slope of a tangent.
      - img
    - article:
      - heading "PRACTICE" [level=3]
      - list:
        - listitem: Find average velocity from t=0 to t=4.
        - listitem: Find instantaneous velocity at t=1.
        - listitem: At what time is velocity 10 m/s?
      - button "View Solutions"
    - article:
      - heading "TRY IT YOURSELF" [level=3]
      - button "Reset matching challenge":
        - img
        - text: Reset
      - paragraph: Make the average rate from t=0 to t=x equal v(2)=6.
      - text: Adjust x
      - slider "Challenge interval end x": "2"
      - status: x=2 · average=4 m/s
      - text: "Keep adjusting: the rates differ."
    - article:
      - heading "REAL-WORLD CONTEXT" [level=3]
      - paragraph: A ball's height after t seconds is s(t)=t²+2t. What are its average and instantaneous velocities?
      - button "Hint":
        - img
        - text: Hint
